utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — the carpool’s still at 7:30, and I’ll spread the word today. I’ll send Pia the pickup time and route, and keep Nell in the loop too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Actually, the carpool is at 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. I’ll send the pickup spot so Uli can get set, and I should be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks for the update — I’ve got it as 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. now, and I’ll pass that along to Pia and Nell.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll text if anything changes. Oren can send me the pickup time and route, and I’ll keep to the 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Rosa’s still confirming a couple seats, and she’ll send the final schedule once that’s set. Quinn’s also spreading the word with the neighbors he usually talks to.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me — I’ll stick with the 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. times until Rosa sends the final schedule. Oren can send me the route when it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Rey’s confirmed for Cleo’s carpool, and I’m still waiting on Tess to nail down the pickup time. Gus may be able to help too, and Leo needs to lock in the pickup spot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the exact pickup time and full route before we count on it?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can’t confirm the exact pickup time or full route yet, but Tess is checking on that now. I’ll let you know as soon as we have it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, I think Uli can do the carpool, and Vik’ll keep everyone posted. Quinn’s asking around today and passing the details along too, including to Pia.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ve got the carpool supplies ready, and if you need backup, Gus may be able to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that helps — I’ll keep Uli and Vik in mind, and maybe Ira can check if they can help this week too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Can you text me the exact pickup time and full route? If it fits my schedule, I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll send the exact pickup time and full route as soon as Rosa sends the final schedule, and I’ll keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — please send it as soon as you have it. I need the exact pickup time and full route before I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep Kira posted if the carpool time shifts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — that helps. I’ll make sure Bo is first, and I’ll keep the rest aligned with the route and pickup spots.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks — just let me know if anything changes, and I’ll pass it along to Kira.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, so Rey’s in and Hana says it’s still on for tomorrow. Should I ask Gus to help, or is Faye handling everything?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Faye’s handling the times, and I’m sending Eli the pickup time and route. If we still need another driver, I can check with Ira about their schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—please ask Ira if another driver is still needed. And send me the pickup time too so I can stay in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still 7:45 for the pickup. I’m the first stop, so that should keep things easy.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, 7:45 works. I’ll let Pia know the exact route and pickup details so she can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — 7:45 it is. I’ll be the first stop, so we should be good.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s still set for 8am at the church parking lot. I’ll keep an eye on the pickup spots as the route gets finalized.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—thanks, Opal. I’ll keep Sam and Lina set for 7:30, with Bo as the first stop and Leo ready at 7:15.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ve got 8am at the church parking lot, with Bo as the first stop and Leo at 7:15.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sam can do the weekday pickups at 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m., and Gus can help too. Rey’s already with Cleo, so those times should work best for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Leo — we’re still set for 8:00 a.m. at the church parking lot, and I’m just confirming a couple of seats now. I’ll send the final schedule once it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — thanks, Rosa. The 8:00 a.m. pickup works for me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do the carpool. Rosa’s locking in a couple seats, and once it’s set she’ll send the final schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli. I’m already in Cleo’s carpool, so I’ll just follow the set schedule.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Got it — Nell will share who’s interested once she hears back, so we should have the full list soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll check whether I can help with the carpool this week. And just to keep it straight, it’s still at 7:30, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, still at 7:30 — I can help with the carpool if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know if I need help with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I can help with the carpool. It’s still set for 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep repeating that it’s set for 7:30 until Rosa sends the final schedule.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — 7:30 it is until Rosa sends the final schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Gus can help out with the carpool if needed. Leo still keeps the weekday pickups at 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — I’ve got that Leo is still handling the weekday 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. pickups. Since Opal has the route and pickup spots covered, I’ll just make sure the first stop is Bo’s.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’m just riding along in Cleo’s carpool, so that works for me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sam can do the weekday pickups at 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. Gus can help too if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — can you send Pia the exact pickup time and full route? Rey’s confirmed, and Tess can keep an ear out if the timing changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — I’ll send Pia the exact 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. pickup times and the full route.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—send me the confirmed times, and I’ll be ready. Leo and Faye can keep coordinating the pickup spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — the confirmed times are 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m., and I’ll send the pick-up spot too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, those times work for me. Send the pickup spot when you’ve got it, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Bo is the first stop, and I’ve got Sam and Lina set for 7:30. Leo’ll be ready at 7:15, and Opal’s handling the pickup spots.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm the exact pickup time and the full route?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — Leo’s at 7:15, then Bo is first on the route, and Sam and Lina are set for 7:30. Opal’s got the pickup spots lined up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, 7:45 is still the pickup time, and I’m the first stop. Opal can keep tracking the route, and I’ll let folks know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’m tracking the route, and the pickup is still the church parking lot at 8am. I’ll note the rest as it goes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hold up — it’s still 7:45, not 8. I’m the first stop, and Opal can keep tracking the route.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No worries — Quinn said they’ll keep you in the loop since you’re still catching up on everyone. And if the carpool time shifts, I’ll let Kira know too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’m still piecing it together, so I appreciate the update. I’ll wait for the final carpool schedule and keep an eye out for Quinn’s word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet — once Quinn sends the final schedule, I’ll pass it along if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—Hana still good for tomorrow, and should I loop in Rey and Gus with Faye?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, please loop them in. Also, the carpool is still at 7:30, and Leo should be ready at 7:15.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I’ll loop in Rey and Gus with Faye, and I’ll make sure Leo’s ready by 7:15 for the 7:30 carpool.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve got the carpool at 7:30, and I’ll spread the word today. I’ll send the pickup time and route to Pia, and keep Nell in the loop too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll send Eli the pickup time and route too. And Ira’s checking whether their schedule can help as an extra driver.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep asking around today and make sure Pia and Nell get the details. If Ira can drive, that’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I’ve got you for the carpool, and we’ll keep the church parking lot at 8am for now. I’m confirming the last couple of seats, then I’ll भेज the final schedule once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I can do the carpool, and I’ll wait for the final schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Uli — I’ll send the final schedule as soon as those last seats are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check with Gus, and Sam can handle the weekday carpool. We still need Leo to lock in the pickup spot, and Rey is already confirmed for Cleo's carpool.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. Once Oren sends the pickup time and route, I’ll text if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—once Oren sends the pickup time and route, I’ll keep everyone posted. Then we just need Leo to confirm the pickup spot.
